name: Yolkie
source:
Yolkie may seem blunt and mean sometimes, but he truly cares for his friends. He is especially close friends with Cotton, who's just like a little brother to him.

He is lazy and doesn't want to work more than necessary. Despite him being a chicken, he never wakes up early!
translation:
Yolkie may seem blunt and mean sometimes, but he truly cares for his friends. He is especially close friends with Cotton, who's just like a little brother to him.

He is lazy and doesn't want to work more than necessary. Despite him being a chicken, he never wakes up early!
